title: Conditioning the tanh-drift process on first-passage times: Exact drifts, bridges, and process equivalences
summary: In this article, we consider the Benes process with drift $μ(x)=α\tanh(αx + β)$, with $α> 0$, $β\in \mathbb{R}$, that is, the diffusion defined by the stochastic differential equation $dX(t)=α\tanh(αX(t)+β)\,dt + dW(t)$, with an absorbing barrier at $x=a$. After deriving the propagator and key associated quantities--the first-passage-time distribution and the survival probability--we then condition this process to have various prescribed first-passage-time distributions. When the conditioning is imposed at an infinite time horizon, this procedure reveals the existence of different processes…
